niche_preference_profile: This user generally prefers clean, breathable interfaces with clear hierarchy, generous spacing, and polished visual grouping. They often favor lighter or softly tinted surfaces, cohesive accent color systems (especially purple, though they can also like soft warm palettes), subtle card treatments, and readable sans-serif typography. They respond well to clear imagery, structured content blocks, consistent icons, and controls that feel simple, legible, and visually refined rather than dense, flashy, overly dark, or heavily embellished.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, generous padding, and layouts that feel breathable rather than dense, cramped, or tightly grouped.
Prefers interfaces with strong structure, clear section emphasis, neatly grouped content, and balanced composition over cluttered or weakly organized layouts.
Prefers cohesive color systems with refined accents—often purple-accented, but also receptive to soft warm palettes—over generic, harsher, or less integrated color treatments.

Prefers soft filled cards or subtly tinted containers, blurred or isolating backdrops, and rounded surfaces rather than harsher outlined panels, plain backgrounds, or visually disconnected containers.
Prefers straightforward readability with clear text hierarchy, readable labels, and friendly sans-serif presentation over stylized, editorial, all-caps, or harder-to-scan typography.
Prefers simple, clear controls and consistent icon systems with minimal ambiguity or decoration over icon-heavy, mixed-style, embellished, or less cohesive controls.
Prefers prominent, clearly visible primary media or preview content, such as bright preview imagery or large album art, with minimal obstruction and clear active-state indicators.
